reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 喚醒時，於 <Tsend> 內以 $VolumeSCV$ 訊號送出 speed controlled volume 之狀態（CFTS022-4915169）。關鍵情境條件：SCV 先設為已知狀態，HU 睡眠後喚醒，於匯流排上觀察 $VolumeSCV$ 之發送時點與值。為什麼這樣切：與 -003 之區辨軸為「內部召回 vs 對外傳送」，觸發措辭亦不同（本條為 wakes up，未限定 Interior CAN），照條文原樣寫。刻意不填具體時間：<Tsend> 在條文內未定義具體值，依 §8.4.1 保留原符號，步驟與 ER 一律寫 <Tsend>，不填入任何秒數或毫秒數。

distinguishing_axis.delta: -004 驗對外訊號之傳送與時限；-003 驗內部狀態之召回

tcs.tc_title: $VolumeSCV$ is sent within <Tsend> when the HU wakes up
tcs.test_item: When the HU wakes up, the HU shall send the status of the speed controlled volume in the $VolumeSCV$ signal within <Tsend>
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The speed controlled volume is set to a known state
2. The HU is asleep
3. A CAN interface tool is connected
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the state of the speed controlled volume
2. Start the CAN trace
3. Trigger the wake-up of the HU
4. Read the first $VolumeSCV$ signal in the CAN trace and its timestamp relative to the wake-up
5. Read the value carried in that $VolumeSCV$ signal
tcs.expected_result:
1. The state of the speed controlled volume is recorded
2. The CAN trace is running
3. The HU is awake
4. The $VolumeSCV$ signal is sent within <Tsend> of the wake-up
5. The $VolumeSCV$ signal carries the state recorded in step 1
